We'll verify evaluatedProperties contains only present.

Null node: expect NullPointerException.

CollectorContext missing validator state: when collectorContext.get(ValidatorState.VALIDATOR_STATE_KEY) returns null; then validator.validate should cause NullPointerException when casting. We'll assert exception.

Null parent schema: construct validator with null parent via reflection: after constructing with null, need to set private field parentSchema? The constructor expects a JsonSchema parent; we can pass null directly if allowed. We'll pass null. Then call validate with node missing property, expect NullPointerException.

Null "at": pass null; atPath may cause NPE; we can assert NPE.

Now implement.

Add utility method getSchemasMap.
